en-US.ADDONS_HINT: Build a .qaddon with the QuartzAddon SDK and put it in UserData/Quartz/Addons, or use Add Addon. Quartz loads addons at launch. Reload reads the folder again.
en-US.ADDONS_RESTART_REQUIRED: Restart the game to fully apply this.
en-US.AD_DISCORD_HINT: Uses your Discord feature login. Join voice from the Discord page, not the Discord app.
en-US.AD_SHORTCUT_HINT: Set this to your Discord 'Toggle Deafen' keybind.
en-US.AD_SHORTCUT_WINDOWS_ONLY: Shortcut mode is Windows-only. Using Bot mode.
en-US.BLOCK_INPUTS_WHILE_MENU_OPEN: Block game inputs while menu is open

en-US.DESC_ACCENT_COLOR: Recolors the whole Quartz UI. Middle-click to reset.
en-US.DESC_ADDONS_ADD: Pick a .qaddon or .dll file to copy into the Addons folder, then reload.
en-US.DESC_ADDONS_OPEN_FOLDER: Opens UserData/Quartz/Addons in your file browser.
en-US.DESC_ADDONS_RELOAD: Unloads all addons, scans the Addons folder again, then reloads them and this window.
en-US.DESC_ADDONS_REMOVE: Deletes this addon's file and settings. You can't undo this.
en-US.DESC_COLOR_PICKER_HORIZONTAL: Puts the color picker side by side instead of stacked. Handy when the window is too short for the tall picker.
en-US.DESC_EDITOR_HORIZONTAL_PROPERTIES: Shows each level editor property as "label [field]" on one row, instead of the label above the field. Applies to the in-game editor, not this window.
en-US.DESC_FAQ_OPEN_FILE: Opens FAQ.json in your default .json app. Creates the default file first if it's missing.
en-US.DESC_FAQ_OPEN_FOLDER: Opens the Quartz data folder that holds FAQ.json and your settings.
en-US.DESC_FAQ_RELOAD: Reads FAQ.json again and rebuilds the list below.
en-US.DESC_FONT_JUDGEMENT: Uses the selected font for the judgement popup on each hit ("Perfect!"/"Early!"). This is the rating text, not the counts above.
en-US.DESC_IMPORT_DO: Copy this mod's settings into Quartz. Settings it doesn't cover are left as they are.
en-US.DESC_IMPORT_PROFILE: Copies this mod's settings into a new Quartz profile. Your current profile stays selected.
en-US.DESC_IMPORT_RESCAN: Looks again for supported mods loaded through Unity Mod Manager.
en-US.DESC_JUDGEMENT_XPERFECT: Splits the Perfect count into early / X / late when X-Perfect judgements show (the game's Perfect text setting, or the XPerfect mod).
en-US.DESC_KEYVIEWER_COUNTFORMAT: Show counters with a thousands separator (1,234).
en-US.DESC_KEYVIEWER_DM_CSS_IMPORT: Pick a DM Note custom CSS file. It goes on top of the preset and restyles keys and counters.
en-US.DESC_KEYVIEWER_DM_IMPORT: Pick a DM Note preset JSON file.
en-US.DESC_KEYVIEWER_EDITOR_EXPORT_JSON: Saves the layout as a plain DM Note preset. Anything DM Note can't show is left out, and you'll see what.
en-US.DESC_KEYVIEWER_EDITOR_EXPORT_QKV: Saves the layout and all Key Viewer settings to a .qkv. Quartz only. Use it to move a layout to another Quartz install.
en-US.DESC_KEYVIEWER_EDITOR_FILE: Import a DM Note preset, save this layout to a file, or rebuild it from your Simple mode settings.
en-US.DESC_KEYVIEWER_EDITOR_FOOT: Adds another foot-key tab, shown next to the hand tab you have open. Choose how many foot keys it starts with.
en-US.DESC_KEYVIEWER_EDITOR_FOOT_DELETE: Hide the foot keys, or delete the foot tab you have open.
en-US.DESC_KEYVIEWER_EDITOR_IMPORT: Pick a DM Note preset JSON file. It replaces the layout you're editing.
en-US.DESC_KEYVIEWER_EDITOR_MIGRATE: Rebuilds this layout from your Simple mode style, key bindings, labels and colours. Overwrites the layout you're editing.
en-US.DESC_KEYVIEWER_EDITOR_TAB_ADD: Adds a hand-key tab with one of the Simple mode key layouts, ready to edit.
en-US.DESC_KEYVIEWER_EDITOR_TAB_DELETE: Removes the hand tab you're editing and everything on it.
en-US.DESC_KEYVIEWER_FOOTSTYLE: Adds a foot-pedal element you can drag on its own in Reorganize mode. Its keys light up when pressed but aren't counted.
en-US.DESC_KEYVIEWER_GHOSTRAINDOTTED: Draws ghost rain as a repeating dash pattern instead of a solid streak (port of JipperResourcePack's ghost rain).
en-US.DESC_KEYVIEWER_GHOSTSET: Click, then press the secondary (ghost) key for this slot. Esc cancels.
en-US.DESC_KEYVIEWER_HIDEMAINCOUNT: Hide the per-key counters on the key boxes.
en-US.DESC_KEYVIEWER_KEYLABEL: Custom text for the selected key. Leave empty to use the bound key's name.
en-US.DESC_KEYVIEWER_PERKEYKPS: Each key box shows that key's presses-per-second instead of its total press count.
en-US.DESC_KEYVIEWER_PK_COLORSENABLE: Gives just this key its own colours. Other keys keep the shared colours until you turn theirs on.
en-US.DESC_KEYVIEWER_PK_COPYGLOBAL: Replaces every key's own colours and font sizes with the current shared values.
en-US.DESC_KEYVIEWER_PK_COPYTHIS: Copy this key's colours onto every key and turn on separate colours for all of them.
en-US.DESC_KEYVIEWER_PK_FONTENABLE: Gives just this key its own font sizes. Other keys keep the shared sizes until you turn theirs on.
en-US.DESC_KEYVIEWER_PK_REBIND: Click, then press the new key for this slot. Esc cancels.
en-US.DESC_KEYVIEWER_RAIN: Streaks rising from a key while it's held.
en-US.DESC_KEYVIEWER_RAINWIDTH: Streak width for the front key row. 0 matches each key's width.
en-US.DESC_KEYVIEWER_RESETCOUNTS: Clears every key's press count and the total.
en-US.DESC_KEYVIEWER_SHOWOUTSIDE: Keeps the key viewer on screen in menus too, not just while playing a level.
en-US.DESC_KEYVIEWER_STREAMER: Hides the KPS and Total stat boxes completely.
en-US.DESC_KEYVIEWER_SYNCLIMITER: Replaces the Key Limiter's allowed keys with the keys shown here, and keeps them in sync when you rebind keys or switch styles.
en-US.DESC_KEYVIEWER_TABUB: Past a set point in the level, note rain stops and a picture covers the key viewer, so viewers can't read your tapping pattern. Presses still count underneath, and everything resets on your next attempt.
en-US.DESC_KEYVIEWER_TABUB_IMAGE: Use your own picture instead of the one that comes with the mod.
en-US.DESC_KEYVIEWER_TABUB_PERCENT: How far into the level the picture appears. It fades in over the second before this point, and fades out over the level's last second.
en-US.DESC_KEYVIEWER_TABUB_SCALE: Sets the picture size. Drag it into place in Reorganize mode.
en-US.DESC_MIDDLE_CLICK_TO_SET_AS_DEFAULT:
Middle-click a setting to reset it to its default.
Settings with a small dot at the top-left support this.
en-US.DESC_PANELS_CREATE: Adds an empty panel. Name it, add stats, then drag it into place in Reorganize.
en-US.DESC_PROFILE_ADD: Creates a new profile from your current settings and switches to it.
en-US.DESC_PROFILE_IMPORT: Loads a .qprofile (or older .krprofile) file as a new profile. It won't be selected for you.
en-US.DESC_PROFILE_RECALIBRATE: Sets this monitor as the reference for overlay positions, keeping them where they are now. On a different-sized display, positions then scale to match.
en-US.DESC_SETTINGS_FONT: Font for Quartz's own settings window. Default is SUIT. "Same as overlay font" follows the Font picker above.
en-US.DESC_UPDATE_CHANNEL: Which builds you get when updating. Alpha gets new builds first, and each step up is more stable. Stable gets only final releases. You stay in the channel you pick, so Alpha offers the newest alpha, not a beta of the same version.
en-US.DESC_UPDATE_NOTES: Opens this release's notes on GitHub.
en-US.DESC_UPDATE_RESTART: Closes the game and starts it again. Uses Steam if you launched from Steam, otherwise relaunches it directly.
en-US.DESC_UPDATE_SKIP: Hides this version. You'll still be offered the next release.
en-US.EDITOR_FLIPROTATE_SHORTCUT_FLIP_V: Ctrl + Shift + L — Flip selection vertically
en-US.FAQ_ERROR: Couldn't read FAQ.json. Showing the built-in questions. {0}
en-US.FAQ_HINT: These questions are in FAQ.json in your Quartz folder. Edit it to reword answers, add your own questions or remove ones you don't need, then press Reload. Delete the file and reload to get the defaults back.
en-US.FEATURES_HINT: Turn any feature on or off. A feature that's off is fully unloaded. Turn a tab off to hide it from the sidebar.
en-US.DESC_FONT_SCALE: Size multiplier for the selected font. Use it when a custom font renders smaller than others. Saved per font.
en-US.DESC_FONT_LINE_SPACING: Line height multiplier for the selected font. Saved per font.
en-US.HOME_CARD_FAILED: Couldn't build this card. Check the log.
en-US.HOME_HINT: Everything Quartz does is in the tabs on the left. Search finds any setting by name.
en-US.HOME_UPDATE_AVAILABLE: An update is available. See Settings.
en-US.HOME_UPDATE_INSTALLED: An update was installed. Restart the game to use it.
en-US.IMPORT_ENABLING: Turning on the features these settings need…
en-US.IMPORT_ERR_PROFILE_SWITCH_BACK: Imported into the profile, but couldn't switch back to your previous profile.
en-US.IMPORT_ERR_SELECT_KEYVIEWER_PART: Pick at least one KeyViewer setting group.
en-US.IMPORT_HINT: Bring your settings over from another ADOFAI mod. Quartz reads each supported mod loaded through Unity Mod Manager and copies what it can. Your other settings stay as they are.
en-US.IMPORT_NONE: No supported mods found. Load one through Unity Mod Manager (KorenResourcePack (v1), JipperResourcePack, JipperKeyViewer, ADOFAI Tweaks, KeyboardChatterBlocker or Enhanced Effect Remover), then press Rescan.
en-US.KEYVIEWER_DMGAP_COUNT_IN_TOTAL: keys kept out of the total
en-US.KEYVIEWER_EDITOR_EXPORTED_JSON_GAPS: Exported for DM Note without {0}. Export as .qkv to keep them.
en-US.KEYVIEWER_EDITOR_EXPORTED_QKV: Exported as .qkv with your layout and Key Viewer settings, for any Quartz install.
en-US.KEYVIEWER_EDITOR_IMPORTED_QKV: Imported. {0} Key Viewer setting(s) from the .qkv replaced yours.
en-US.KEYVIEWER_EDITOR_IMPORT_EMPTY: No presets found. Put a .qkv or .json in {0}
en-US.KEYVIEWER_EDITOR_MIGRATE_HINT: This layout is empty. Migrate rebuilds it from your Simple mode settings.
en-US.KEYVIEWER_EDITOR_TAB_MAX: You have {0} tabs, the most DM Note allows.
en-US.KEYVIEWER_FOOT_HINT: Foot keys are their own element. Drag them anywhere in Reorganize mode.
en-US.KEYVIEWER_KEYS_HINT: Click a key to open its editor.
en-US.KEYVIEWER_PK_COPYTHIS: Copy This Key's Colors to All Keys
en-US.KEYVIEWER_PK_FONTENABLE: Separate Font Sizes For This Key
en-US.PROFILE_HINT: All your settings live in the active profile. Before updating the mod by hand, export your profile. If UserData gets replaced, import it back.
en-US.PROFILE_STATUS_IMPORT_FAILED: Import failed. Not a Quartz profile file.
en-US.QUIZ_MERCY: Fine. The quiz gives up on you. Go in.
en-US.SEARCH_HINT: Type to search every tab: categories, toggles, buttons and more.
en-US.TOGGLE_BIND_HINT: Right-click a toggle to give it its own hotkey. Press Esc while binding to clear it.
en-US.UPDATE_FAILED_NETWORK: Couldn't reach GitHub. Check your connection.
en-US.UPDATE_FAILED_NOT_FOUND: Update check failed. Release feed not found.
en-US.UPDATE_FAILED_RATE_LIMIT: GitHub rate limit reached. Try again later.
en-US.UPDATE_INSTALLED: Update installed. Restart the game to apply it.
en-US.UPDATE_RESTART_FAILED: Couldn't restart for you. Close and reopen the game.
en-US.UPDATE_SKIPPED: Skipped {0}. You won't see it again.
en-US.HOME_RESET_DESC: Reset puts every setting back to default. Clean also empties key layouts, panels and key lists. Feature switches, addons and other profiles stay. Restart the game after.
en-US.INACTIVE_HINT: Every feature is off. Turn Quartz back on to change settings.
en-US.DESC_KEYVIEWER_EDITOR_TAB_DUPLICATE: Copies the hand tab you are editing, with every element on it, into a new tab.
en-US.DESC_KEYVIEWER_EDITOR_FOOT_DUPLICATE: Copies the foot tab you have open, with every element on it, into a new foot tab.
en-US.FEATURE_OFF_HINT: This feature is off. Turn it on to see its settings.
en-US.FEATURE_OFF_NEEDS: This feature needs {0}. Turning it on turns that on too.
en-US.DESC_CALIBRATION_DETAILED_DISPLAY: Shows average, max and min timing on the calibration screen.
en-US.DESC_CALIBRATION_FLOAT_OFFSET: Lets your input offset use decimals. In the pause menu, hold Ctrl or Shift for .1 or .01ms steps.
en-US.DESC_CALIBRATION_POPUP_ON_DEATH: When you die, we'll suggest a new input offset from this run's average timing.
en-US.DESC_CALIBRATION_SONG_USE_MINIMUM: Fixes calibration values coming out too small after the planet goes around a full loop.
en-US.DESC_DL_MESSAGE: Shows on the fail screen when a limit ends your run.
en-US.DESC_EDITOR_BGA_HIDE_PLANET_DECO: Also hides decorations attached to planets while BGA Mod hides the level. Background and camera-anchored decorations stay visible.
en-US.DESC_EDITOR_BGA_HIDE_TILE_DECO: Also hides decorations attached to tiles while BGA Mod hides the level. Background and camera-anchored decorations stay visible.
en-US.DESC_EDITOR_BGA_MOD: Hides all tiles and planets during play so only the background shows. Use it to record a background animation (BGA) to put gameplay over. The edit view isn't affected, only play-test and real play.
en-US.DESC_EDITOR_SHOW_FLOOR_ANGLE: Shows the total angle of the selected tiles in degrees, on one of those tiles. Works in the in-game editor, not this window.
en-US.DESC_EDITOR_SHOW_FLOOR_BEATS: Shows the selected tiles' length in beats (total angle ÷ 180), on one of those tiles. Works in the in-game editor, not this window.
en-US.DESC_EDITOR_SHOW_FLOOR_COUNT: Shows how many tiles you've selected, on one of those tiles. Works in the in-game editor, not this window.
en-US.DESC_EDITOR_SHOW_FLOOR_DURATION: Shows how many seconds the selected tiles take to play, on one of those tiles. Works in the in-game editor, not this window.
en-US.DESC_EDITOR_USE_TULTTAK_BEHAVIOR: Works like the Tulttak mod: the last selected tile isn't counted in the angle, beats, and duration totals.
en-US.EDITOR_USE_TULTTAK_BEHAVIOR: Don't count the last tile in timing
en-US.DESC_EDITOR_FLIP_ADJUST: When you flip the selected tiles, their Position Track coordinates flip too, so anything placed by those events moves with the tiles.
en-US.DESC_EDITOR_ROTATE_ADJUST: When you rotate the selected tiles, their Position Track coordinates rotate by the same angle, so anything placed by those events turns with the tiles.
en-US.DESC_EDITOR_CUSTOM_ANGLE: The rotate shortcut turns the selected tiles by the angle below instead of 90°. The 180° shortcut always stays 180°.
en-US.EDITOR_DECO_PREVIEW: Preview decoration images in the list
en-US.DESC_EDITOR_DECO_PREVIEW: Shows each decoration's own image next to its entry in the level editor's decoration list, so you can tell them apart without selecting them. Text and object entries keep the default icon, and so do particles with a missing image.
en-US.EDITOR_DECO_PREVIEW_CREDIT: Ported from DecoPreview by rdzip, licensed under the GNU GPL v3.
en-US.DESC_FXRM_DECO_FAILHITBOX: Removes decorations whose hitbox can fail you (HitboxType: Kill), whatever the type toggles above say.
en-US.DESC_FXRM_ENABLE_SAVE: The editor has the stripped chart, so saving overwrites the file and the removed effects are lost for good. Off blocks saving while Enhanced is on.
en-US.DESC_FXRM_REMOVE_ALL_DECO: Off keeps decorations used for hit/miss feedback and removes the rest.
en-US.DESC_FXRM_TUTORIAL_PATTERNS: Also hides the default background's tiled pattern. Its pulsing shapes are always removed while Background is on.
en-US.DESC_FXRM_S_FILTER: Turns off VFX filters (Grayscale, Arcade, etc.) in play. The chart isn't changed.
en-US.DESC_FXRM_S_ADVFILTER: Turns off Advanced Filter VFX in play. The chart isn't changed.
en-US.DESC_FXRM_S_HOM: Skips the Hall of Mirrors effect.
en-US.DESC_FXRM_S_SCREENTILE: Turns off screen tiling (kaleidoscope/repeat) and screen scroll in play. The chart isn't changed.
en-US.DESC_FXRM_S_MOVEMAX: Limits how many tiles one Move Track event can move. Max means no limit.
en-US.DESC_KL_CAPTURE: Press a key to add or remove it. Press Escape to cancel.
en-US.KL_SYNC_LOCKED: Key Viewer manages these keys (Sync Keys to Key Limiter is on).
en-US.KL_CHART_NOTE: Adds a Key Limiter event to the level editor. From a chosen tile, a chart can cap how many different keys you use and decide what an extra press does: ignore it, end the run, or fire tagged events. Reopen the level after changing this.
en-US.DESC_CHARTKEYLIMITER_ENABLE: Lets levels use a Key Limiter event and applies it while you play.
en-US.DESC_KEYVIEWER_JS_ENABLED: Runs imported DM Note-style JavaScript plugins in a limited Jint sandbox. Only load plugins you trust.
en-US.DESC_KEYVIEWER_JS_IMPORT: Import a .js or .mjs plugin made for DM Note's declarative defineElement API.
en-US.DESC_KVI_REBIND: Click, then press the new key for this element. Esc cancels.
en-US.DESC_KVI_GHOST_SET: Click, then press a second key. It lights up this element but doesn't count as a press. Esc cancels.
en-US.DESC_KVI_COUNTINTOTAL: Adds this key's presses to the Total stat. Turn it off for foot keys or anything you don't want counted.
en-US.DESC_KVI_IDLE_TRANSPARENT: Hides the background while the key is up. The border and label stay, and your colour is saved.
en-US.DESC_KVI_ACTIVE_TRANSPARENT: Hides the background while the key is held. The border and label stay.
en-US.DESC_KVI_NOTE_GRADIENT: Fades the rain between two colours, top to bottom, instead of one flat colour.
en-US.DESC_KVI_NOTE_GLOW_GRADIENT: Fades the glow between two colours, top to bottom, instead of one flat colour.
en-US.DESC_KVI_IMAGE_IDLE: Use a full file path, a file:// or http(s):// URL, or a data: URI. Web images download once and are cached. The image is cut to the element's shape.
en-US.DESC_KVI_IMAGE_ACTIVE: Shows only while the key is held. Leave it empty to keep the idle image.
en-US.DESC_KVI_INLINE_PRIORITY: Keeps this element's own colours, sizes and press scale even if the custom stylesheet sets them. CSS-only effects like gradients, glows and pseudo layers still apply.
en-US.DESC_KVI_CLASS: Class names for the custom stylesheet, separated by spaces. A rule like .blue[data-state="active"] will then target this element.
en-US.DESC_KVI_NOTE_AUTOY: Starts this element's rain at the top of the shared track, not at the element. Turn it off to give a lower element its own shorter track.
en-US.DESC_KVI_COUNTER_ENABLED: Shows this element's press count. The Key Viewer's Show Counter setting also needs to be on.
en-US.DESC_KVI_COUNTER_PERKEYKPS: Shows this key's own presses per second instead of its total. The total still counts.
en-US.KVI_COUNTER_MODE_HINT: Center puts the label and count on one line. Between pushes them to opposite edges.
en-US.DESC_KVI_ADD_KEY: Adds a new key in the middle of the view. Bind it in the panel beside it.
en-US.DESC_KVI_ADD_STAT: Adds a new readout in the middle of the view. Pick its number in the panel beside it.
en-US.DESC_KVI_ADD: Adds a key, readout or KPS graph to the middle of the view.
en-US.DESC_KVI_ADD_GRAPH: Adds a new KPS graph in the middle of the view.
en-US.DESC_KVI_DUPLICATE: Copies the selected elements, shifted a little from the originals.
en-US.DESC_KVI_Z_FRONT: Moves the selected elements one step in front of what they overlap.
en-US.DESC_KVI_Z_BACK: Moves the selected elements one step behind what they overlap.
en-US.DESC_KVI_DELETE: Removes the selected elements from this tab.
en-US.DESC_KVI_REDO: Brings back the edits you undid.
en-US.DESC_KVI_ZOOM_OUT: Zooms out. You can also press - over the canvas.
en-US.DESC_KVI_ZOOM_IN: Zooms in. You can also press + over the canvas.
en-US.DESC_KVI_ZOOM_RESET: Goes back to actual size at the top-left of the layout. You can also press 0.
en-US.DESC_KVI_ZOOM_FIT: Shows every element on this tab. Handy if you've panned the layout out of sight.
en-US.DESC_KVI_SNAP: Snaps dragging and resizing to the grid and nearby edges. Turn it off to move and size one pixel at a time. Arrow keys always move one pixel. Hold Alt while dragging to skip snapping.
en-US.KVI_TOOLBAR_HINT: Scroll, or drag with the middle or right mouse button, to pan. + and - zoom, 0 resets to actual size. Arrow keys nudge, Delete removes.
en-US.DESC_KVI_HIDDEN: Keeps the selected elements in the layout, but hides them in game and stops counting their presses. They show dimmed on the canvas, so you can still select them and turn them back on.
en-US.KVI_EMPTY: Select an element on the canvas to edit it. Drag a box around several to edit them together.
en-US.DESC_KVI_COUNTER_SHOWWHILEPRESSING: Keeps the counter visible while the key is held. Turn it off to hide it until you let go. Its space stays reserved, so the label won't move.
en-US.DESC_KVI_LABEL_ENABLED: Shows this element's label. Turn it off and the counter fills the whole box. The box, border and rain stay the same.
en-US.DESC_KVI_COPY_STYLE: Copies the look of the selected element: colors, shape, text, notes and counter. Ctrl+Shift+C does the same.
en-US.DESC_KVI_PASTE_STYLE: Gives the selected elements the copied look. Position, size, key and label stay. Ctrl+Shift+V does the same.
en-US.DESC_TW_MENUBPM: Sets the menu rabbit's two speeds to the BPMs below instead of 1x / 2x. Reopen the menu to apply.
en-US.DESC_TW_MENUMUSIC: Mutes the theme song on the title and island-select screens. Works right away and doesn't touch gameplay music.
en-US.DESC_OPT_CACHESCREENSCALE: The game rescales its four full-screen flash quads every frame, even when the camera's size and aspect haven't changed. This skips that work when both match the last frame and runs normally as soon as either changes.
en-US.DESC_OPT_COLLECTONLOAD: Runs garbage collection each time a scene loads, so every run starts with a clean heap. Loading already stutters, so this costs you nothing.
en-US.DESC_OPT_FASTBLOOM: Makes ADOFAI's bloom use its cheaper low-quality path while bloom is on. This cuts real GPU work and can raise FPS on bloom-heavy levels. Bloom looks a bit softer.
en-US.DESC_OPT_LEAKGUARD: Fixes known memory leaks in the game: decoration render textures and materials left after a level unloads, frame-rate effect screen buffers, workshop thumbnails, practice-mode waveforms, and caches that only grow. Keeps RAM from creeping up in long sessions.
en-US.DESC_OPT_LOSSYTEXTURE: Compresses custom textures loaded from disk (DXT) to use about 4-8x less memory, with a small quality loss. Applies to textures loaded after you turn it on.
en-US.DESC_OPT_PAUSEOFFSCREENPARTICLES: Stops particle decorations from simulating on the CPU while they're off camera, instead of letting the game decide per system. Saves CPU on particle-heavy levels. A system that comes back into view resumes where it paused instead of catching up, so its timing can differ. Off by default.
en-US.DESC_OPT_PRIORITY: Asks the OS to give the game steadier CPU time (Above Normal priority). Works on Windows. Ignored where the system doesn't allow it (usually macOS/Linux).
en-US.DESC_OPT_RENDERHITSOUNDS: At very high note density (Hz / high-KPS charts), the game can't play every hit sound, so overlapping hits get dropped. This mixes all of a level's hit sounds into one audio track and plays that instead, so none are lost. It replaces the game's hit sounds while on and uses a little CPU and memory. Off by default.
en-US.DESC_OPT_RUNINBG: Keeps the game running at full speed when its window loses focus, so your run or practice doesn't stall when you alt-tab.
en-US.DESC_OPT_SKIPIDLEPARTICLES: Each particle decoration writes its shape scale and simulation speed to Unity every frame, even if nothing changed. This skips those writes while the values and song pitch stay the same. Off while editing, and it resets when a particle event reloads, so values never go stale.
en-US.DESC_OPT_SKIPNOOPFILTERS: Skips ADOFAI's full-screen screen-tile/screen-scroll shader passes when they'd change nothing on screen, and does a plain copy instead. This cuts real render work without wrapping a game setting.
en-US.DESC_OPT_SMOOTHGC: Holds off garbage collection during a level and runs it when the run ends, so a GC pause can't hit mid-run and throw off your timing. Memory grows during the run (very long levels get a safety collect). Works best with Clean Heap On Load.
en-US.DESC_OTTO_HIGHBPM_ON: On: Otto uses the color below when the level's top BPM is 300+ (where vanilla turns him red). Off: he always uses the normal color.
en-US.DESC_OTTO_IMAGE: Pick a PNG or JPG to use as Otto. Leave it empty to use the cat that comes with the mod.
en-US.DESC_OTTO_TINT_IMAGE: On: your image gets the colors below, like the built-in one. Off: it keeps its own colors and only dims while auto is off.
en-US.DESC_OVERLAY_ENABLED: Turns every overlay on or off: panels, progress bar, combo and judgement.
en-US.DESC_OVERLAY_FPS_SMOOTH: How long the FPS counter holds each value. 0 updates every frame. Higher values make the number change slower and steadier.
en-US.DESC_OVERLAY_POP: Overlays slide in from the screen edge when a run starts, and back out when you die or clear.
en-US.OVERLAY_POP_EXIT: Slide Out on Death or Clear
en-US.DESC_OVERLAY_POP_EXIT: Overlays slide off screen when the run ends. Turn this off to keep them on screen.
en-US.DESC_PANEL_ADDSTAT: Pick a stat to add to this panel.
en-US.DESC_PANEL_BGCOLOR: Panel background color. The A (alpha) slider sets opacity. Turn on Background Panel to see it.
en-US.DESC_PANEL_IMAGE_CHOOSE: Pick a PNG or JPG. A file name alone is looked up in PanelImages, so images kept there move with your config.
en-US.DESC_PANEL_IMAGE_SIZE: Image height as a multiple of this panel's font size.
en-US.DESC_PANEL_LAYER: Drag to reorder. Panels higher in the list show on top when they overlap.
en-US.DESC_PANEL_LOCALIZESTATS: Off: this panel's stat labels stay English (X-Acc, Max X-Acc…). On: they follow the UI language.
en-US.DESC_PANEL_NAME: Shown on the panel while you rearrange, and as this section's title.
en-US.DESC_PANEL_PREFIX: Extra line shown at the top of the panel.
en-US.DESC_PANEL_STATCOLOR_MAXBPM: BPM that maps to the 100% end of the gradient.
en-US.DESC_PANEL_STATCOLOR_ON: Colors this stat's value by blending the colors below over its 0–100% range.
en-US.DESC_PANEL_STATCOLOR_PERFECT: Uses this color instead of the gradient when the stat is exactly 100%, like v1's gold accuracy.
en-US.PANEL_ALL_STATS_ADDED: All stats are already on this panel.
en-US.PANEL_TOO_MANY: {0} panels is a lot. The game may slow down.
en-US.DESC_PCOL_RECOLOR: Off: planets keep their own look (gold, DLC, etc.) and only the overlay image and ring settings apply.
en-US.DESC_PCOL_SEP_TAIL: Off: tails use the ball color (with their own opacity). On: each planet's tail gets its own color.
en-US.DESC_PCOL_RING: Paint the planet ring a custom color. Off hides the ring while planet colors are on.
en-US.DESC_PCOL_SEP_RING: Off: every planet's ring uses one color. On: each planet gets its own ring color.
en-US.DESC_PCOL_OVERLAY_ON: Draws an image on top of each planet. Relative paths are read from the level's folder, so charts can bring their own art. Hidden while editing a level.
en-US.PRACTICE_HINT: Bind a key to a difficulty and a pitch. Changes apply between attempts, never mid-run. Difficulty waits until the current attempt ends. Pitch is written once into the level's Pitch setting, as if you typed it. Queued changes show an arrow in the readout.
en-US.DESC_PRACTICE_KEY: Press any key to bind it. Escape cancels.
en-US.DESC_PRACTICE_SHOWINDICATOR: Shows the difficulty the game is really on. The in-game selector doesn't always keep up.
en-US.DESC_PRACTICE_SHOWSPEED: Shows the level's current Pitch next to the difficulty.
en-US.DESC_PROGRESSBAR_PREFILLSTART: If you start mid-chart (checkpoint or editor play), the bar starts filled up to that point.
en-US.DESC_PROGRESSBAR_USEMAPTIME: Move the bar by the chart's elapsed time, not tiles cleared. It fills smoothly instead of stepping on each tile.
en-US.DESC_PROGRESSBAR_FILLGRADIENT: Change the fill color as the run goes from 0% to 100%, instead of one flat color.
en-US.DESC_PROGRESSBAR_STYLE: Modern is a floating rounded bar. Line is a thin strip across the top or bottom of the screen.
en-US.DESC_PROGRESSBAR_LINEEDGE: The screen edge the line sticks to. It always spans the full width.
en-US.DESC_JR_MESSAGE: Shown on the fail screen when the restriction ends your run.
en-US.DESC_JR_SECTIONS_ADD: Add another percent range of the level. Up to 16.
en-US.DESC_JR_SECTIONS_ON: Only apply the restriction inside the ranges below. When off, it applies to the whole level.
en-US.JR_MESSAGE_HINT: Use {judgement} for the judgement you broke.
en-US.JR_NO_SECTIONS: No sections yet, so the restriction won't trigger.
en-US.DESC_SONGTITLE_STRIP: Remove rich text tags (size, color, ...) and line breaks from the title.
en-US.SPECIALDAY_HINT: Turn the game's seasonal events on or off regardless of the date. Changes show after the next scene load.
en-US.DESC_TILEARC_INTENSITY: How far the rounded corner reaches, as a % of tile width. 100% is a full half-circle, 0% keeps the turn sharp.
en-US.TUF_TAGLINE: Browse community levels, download them, then load them in the editor.
en-US.TUF_OFFLINE: Couldn't reach TUF. Check your connection.
en-US.TUF_UNSAVED_BODY: You have unsaved changes in the editor. Save them before loading this TUF level?
en-US.TUF_EXIT_PLAY_FAILED: Couldn't leave play mode. Stop the run, then try again.
en-US.TUF_CHART_LOAD_REJECTED: The game couldn't load this level. It may need another mod.
en-US.TUF_LAUNCH_STATE_ERROR: Couldn't clear a conflicting TUFHelper launch state.
en-US.TUF_EDITOR_INIT_FAILED: The editor didn't finish starting. Check your other mods.
en-US.TUF_EDITOR_CLOSED: The editor closed before the TUF level loaded.
en-US.TUF_CHART_UNPLAYABLE: Couldn't load the downloaded chart, or it isn't playable.
en-US.TUF_CHART_LOAD_TIMEOUT: The downloaded chart didn't finish loading in the editor.
en-US.TUF_PACKS_TAGLINE: Browse level packs, open one, then load its levels.
en-US.TUF_PACK_NO_LEVELS: This pack has no playable levels.
en-US.DESC_TUF_OPEN_FOLDER: Opens the folder where downloaded TUF levels are saved.
en-US.DESC_TUF_LINK_HELPER: Saves levels into TUFHelperLite's Downloads folder (as tuf-<id>), so both mods share one library. Looks in UMMMods first, then Mods, inside the game folder.
en-US.DESC_TUF_PREVIEWS: Shows a blurred image from each level's YouTube video behind it. Turn off to skip downloading thumbnails.
en-US.DESC_TUF_GRID_VIEW: Shows levels as a grid of cards instead of a list. Columns follow the window width.
en-US.DESC_TUF_INSTALLED: Show only the levels you have downloaded, newest first. Works offline.
en-US.TUF_INSTALLED_EMPTY: You haven't downloaded any levels yet.
en-US.TUF_INSTALLED_NO_MATCH: No downloaded levels match your search.
en-US.TUF_INSTALLED_UNKNOWN: Downloaded before Quartz saved level details.
en-US.DESC_TUF_UPDATE_BADGE: Click to check if TUF has a newer upload of this level. If there's an update, click again to download it over your copy.
en-US.DESC_TUF_CHECK_UPDATES: Checks TUF for newer uploads of every level in your library. It sends one request per level, so big libraries take a moment. Quartz checks once a day by itself. When updates are ready, click to queue them all.
en-US.DESC_TUF_QUEUED: Waiting for the current download. Click to remove it from the queue.
en-US.DESC_TUF_ROLLBACK: Go back to the version you had before an update. Quartz keeps the last few copies in the rollback folder in your levels folder.
en-US.TUF_ROLLBACK_TITLE: Roll back to an earlier version
en-US.TUF_ROLLBACK_MISSING: That rollback copy isn't on disk anymore.
en-US.TUF_ROLLBACK_FAILED: Couldn't roll back this level. Check the log.
en-US.DESC_TUF_DELETE: Deletes this level from your library. Click twice to confirm. You can download it again.
en-US.TUF_DELETE_FAILED: Couldn't delete this level. Check the log.
en-US.TUF_NO_SPACE: Not enough space on the drive with {0}. This level needs {1}, but only {2} is free.
en-US.DESC_TUF_PICK_FOLDER: Pick an empty folder for downloaded levels, like one on a bigger drive. Levels you already have move there.
en-US.DESC_TUF_RESET_FOLDER: Moves levels back to Quartz's folder in the mod directory.
en-US.TUF_LIBRARY_LINK_OVERRIDE: The TUFHelperLite link above is on, so levels go there and this folder isn't used.
en-US.TUF_MOVE_PROGRESS: Moving levels to the new folder… {0}/{1}
en-US.TUF_MOVE_DONE: Moved {0} level(s) to the new folder.
en-US.TUF_MOVE_FAILED_COUNT: Couldn't move {0} level(s). They stayed where they were: {1}
en-US.TUF_FOLDER_NOT_EMPTY: Pick an empty folder. Quartz manages everything in the levels folder, so it won't use one that already has your files.
en-US.TUF_FOLDER_VOLUME_ROOT: Pick a folder on the drive, not the drive itself.
en-US.TUF_FOLDER_NESTED: That folder is inside Quartz's levels folder.
en-US.TUF_FOLDER_BUSY: Levels are still moving. Try again when it's done.
en-US.TUF_FOLDER_LINKED: Turn off the TUFHelperLite link first. While it's on, levels install in that mod's folder.
en-US.TUF_FOLDER_SYMLINK: That folder is a link. Pick a real folder.
en-US.TUF_FOLDER_UNUSABLE: You can't use that folder for levels.
en-US.DESC_TW_NOPAUSE: With auto-play on, the game pauses by itself (e.g. when the window loses focus). This stops those auto pauses. You can still pause manually.
en-US.DESC_TW_SCROLL: Ignores the mouse wheel while you play, so a stray scroll can't change anything mid-run.
en-US.DESC_UIH_RECMODE: The profile in use right now. Off is Playing, on is Recording.
en-US.DESC_UIH_PLAY_SHORTCUT: Hides the game's on-screen keyboard shortcut hints, like "Space: Pause".
en-US.DESC_UIH_REC_SHORTCUT: Hides the game's on-screen keyboard shortcut hints, like "Space: Pause".
en-US.DESC_TW_BCP: Removes the planets' core and spark particles.
en-US.DESC_TW_CP: Removes checkpoint icons and behavior from the level, so dying always restarts the run. After turning this off, reload the level to get icons back.
en-US.DESC_TW_GLOW: Turns off the glow flash on tiles when the planet lands on them.
en-US.DESC_TW_PGLOW: Hides the glow sprite drawn around the planets.
en-US.DESC_TW_SBPM: Labels each speed-change tile with its new BPM and/or multiplier, above or below the tile so its icon stays visible.
en-US.TW_SBPM: Show BPM On Speed Change Tiles
